prompt: Button opened first and hero is in the big blind with T6o. Which compact preflop action fits this transfer spot?
why_v1: The big blind is out of position and T6o is too weak to continue cleanly against a button open.
feedback_correct_v1: Correct. Weak offsuit hand plus out-of-position pressure makes folding the disciplined preflop action.
feedback_incorrect_v1: Incorrect. T6o in the big blind is too weak to continue cleanly after the button opens, so the compact action is fold.
